newsitem.title: BAHRAIN: PRESS DIGEST - Saudi newspapers - June 1.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Saudi newspapers - June 1.

text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the Saudi Arabian press on Sunday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Gulf Arab states' foreign ministers call for better ties with Iran.
- Al-Salam Aircraft Company signs a 400 million riyal contract with a U.S. company.
- Kingdom executes a Yemeni for killing a Saudi man.
- Saudi Arabia's negotiations to join World Trade Organisation were successful, commerce minister says.
